prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone full-body transparent PNG game reaction sprite. Image 2 is ONLY the pose reference from childhood: do not copy its clothes or child proportions.  Whole body including hands and shoes inside canvas with generous padding. TRUE transparent alpha background with clean cutout edges. No glow, halo, bloom, ambient haze, background, floor or cast shadow. No words, logos, watermark or other people. The same female character now a young ADULT WOMAN: recognizable brown side ponytail on viewer's right with coral hair tie and brown bangs, friendly mature face with simple dot eyes, large rounded head like the proportion reference. Yellow open cardigan over a plain ivory blouse, coral knee-length skirt, simple reddish-brown low-heeled closed shoes. Compact mature cartoon silhouette with modest natural adult proportions, not a tall adolescent or toddler. Keep this outfit unchanged across all poses. Requested action: enthusiastic encouraging grin, both fists raised beside chest in a cheering pose, leaning forward with energetic stance Preserve the adult model's outfit from image 1, its large head and short compact body. Never stretch the legs or make a lanky teenager.
